messages:
Priya V: ran into a weird flow during the onboarding workshop. fresh linux VM, ran the curl|sh installer, then `redwoodctl login --profile demo` failed with an endpoint mismatch.
Sam G: what did the installer print during setup? any discovery warnings?
Priya V: it printed: 'Discovery timeout, falling back to cached endpoint: https://internal-auth.redwood.local' and I missed it.
Elliot: hmm installer should not silently inject internal endpoints for interactive installs. that causes TLS and routing surprises for dev machines.
Priya V: exact error: `Post "https://auth.redwood.local/oauth/device": EOF` then `x509: certificate signed by unknown authority` when I retried.
Sam G: quick workaround: `redwoodctl config set profile.demo.endpoint https://auth.redwood.ai` then `REDWOODCTL_SKIP_DISCOVERY=1 redwoodctl login --profile demo --method device`. the env var forces use of the explicit endpoint.
Priya V: that worked. but for workshop attendees that's too much friction.
Elliot: agreed. proposal: change installer interactive flow to prefer public endpoints unless `--preserve-internal` is passed. also surface a clear message: "Could not complete discovery; not overwriting public endpoint unless --preserve-internal provided."
QA Bot: added test case: simulate discovery unreachable -> installer should prompt instead of merging cached endpoints. ticket QA-311 created.
Sam G: small CLI note: `redwoodctl local-serve --profile demo --trust-ca /tmp/corp-ca.pem` helps local-serve accept corp certs for dev VMs (no system install). include that in troubleshooting.
Priya V: also noticed `redwoodctl login` retries behaved differently from SDK: the CLI gave up fast, SDK retries longer before failing which confused our integration tests. might be worth aligning retry policy.
Elliot: good catch — filed DEVEX-1602: "align CLI auth retry/backoff with SDK default behavior". QA should add regression to e2e.
DevEx Bot: PR opened by Elliot: github.com/redwood-inference/installer/pull/521 — installer now warns and asks for confirmation before preserving cached endpoints in interactive mode.
Priya V: lovely. will retest with the workshop VMs tomorrow and update the onboarding doc with the trust-ca and env var workarounds. thanks folks :raised_hands:
